method: tests/test_dispatch_return_bytes.py measure(): UTF-8 bytes of json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False) for the RETURN_SCHEMA, the Codex strict schema and one representative done return (SHARED content, plus the LEGACY fields while the schema required them). The record is the whole done record as saved after one fake-transport dispatch (one commit, the same envelope with the return's JSON text in its result), parsed and re-serialized with indent=2 and no trailing newline, after _host_neutral() held constant: the harness root in every string (as <root>, in both its given and resolved spelling), cli_path, supervisor_pid, notify, results (the notify delivery text), worktree_s, duration_s and the env name list (each at a fixed value wherever the key occurs). Every other field is as saved. Before and after both ran this same measure() and payload(): before with src/, tests/dispatch_helpers.py and tests/conftest.py restored from the earlier code, after at the final code. The before and after record numbers were each identical under two basetemp lengths. Byte counts only; no timing is claimed.
typed_verdict_field: The optional verdict enum and whole-review summary description give schema_bytes 1758 -> 1760 (+2), codex_schema_bytes 1989 -> 2012 (+23, including the required nullable verdict), and record_bytes 7732 -> 7749 (+17 for verdict in options.json_schema). The same measure() leaves the ordinary return unchanged at 283 bytes. All remain below the legacy before; no size target changes.
fixture_repo_name: record_bytes 7463 -> 7459: the fixture repo is named `alpha-api` instead of a 13-character name, and the record carries it once in `repo` (-4 bytes). No field changed.
obligation_fields: record_bytes 7153 -> 7177: the done record carries `"verdict_read": null` (+24 bytes, obligation model). 7177 -> 7199: it carries `"task_check": null` (+22 bytes, pickup check summary, null when the caller ran none).
work_order_fields: Plan C2 adds work_order, work_order_url and work_order_sha256 to bind the approved vault file to the launch. The same measure() now gives 7463 record bytes (+264); schema and return bytes are unchanged. This deliberately retires the 7199-byte record shape, not the measured reduction against the legacy record.
client_version_fields: Audit 10 plan.md section C2 (line 121) requires recording client versions. The whole record now includes client_versions for attempt 1: the client, resolved command prefix and version. The fake CLI path is held as <cli_path> wherever it occurs, including the command prefix; its version is the fixture CLI's 9.9.9 (Claude Code). The same measure() gives 7618 record bytes (+159). This retires the exact 7459-byte shape; schema/return sizes and the reduction against the legacy record remain checked.
findings_field: Feature 039 R1 adds the optional `findings` array (id?, severity, summary, path?, line?) to RETURN_SCHEMA. The same measure() under the same HELD values gives schema_bytes 1353 -> 1758 (+405) and codex_schema_bytes 1479 -> 1989 (+510: the strict form also lists every finding field as required and nullable). record_bytes 7618 -> 7636 (+18): the record's options.json_schema list of property names gains the line `      "findings",`. return_bytes is unchanged at 283 because the representative return sends no findings. This retires the 1353/1479/7618 shape; every figure stays below the legacy before, which is still checked. No size target is set by this change.
result_head_field: Feature 039 #11 records the attempt's end commit on the done record as `result_head` {attempt, sha}, so a landing can prove the result is in a pinned tip. The same measure() gives record_bytes 7636 -> 7732 (+96), all from that one key: `  "result_head": {` 19, `    "attempt": 1,` 18, `    "sha": "<40 hex>"` 54, `  },` 5 (newlines counted). The sha has a fixed length, so the figure does not vary with the commit; it was identical across repeated runs. No source intents are saved for this representative dispatch (no feature), so no other field changed. schema_bytes, codex_schema_bytes and return_bytes are unchanged. This retires the 7636-byte shape; every figure stays below the legacy before, which is still checked.
superseded: Earlier figures 10026 (before) and 7562 (after) came from different methods: the before was the raw saved file, the after a re-serialized record with only three fields held. They are not comparable and are not used.
